title: Show detailed info for a specific USB device
summary: Display verbose technical details for one specific USB device identified by its bus and device number. Requires administrator rights.

steps.explain: Use sudo lsusb with --verbose and the -s flag to show detailed information for a specific USB device. Replace <BUS> and <DEVICE_NUMBER> with the values from the basic lsusb list.

placeholders.name: BUS
placeholders.description: The bus number of the USB device

placeholders.name: DEVICE_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The device number on that bus

steps.expect: Verbose technical details for only the specified USB device.
